verdict.stance: Overweight / Rapid Deleveraging via $500m CB Early Redemption & Precious Metals Surge
verdict.summary: Sibanye announced in Nov-26 the early redemption of its $500m 4.25% 2028 convertible bond to slash gross debt toward ~$1.1bn, backed by Q326 adj EBITDA rising 9% YoY to $662m (R10.8bn) and 0.59x YE25 net leverage. Eliminating the 2028 CB removes ~1/3 of gross debt and de-risks the 2029/2031 senior notes.

positives: Nov-26 early redemption of $500m 4.25% CB halves gross debt toward $1.1bn target.
Low 0.59x net leverage at YE25 with ~$1.0bn cash and surging gold/PGM basket cash flows.
Diversified South African gold/PGM, US PGM/recycling, and Keliber lithium portfolio.
negatives: US PGM strike disruption in Montana weighing on Stillwater volumes.
High SA labor/electricity cost inflation and PGM price cyclicality.
Exposure to South Africa macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.

recovery_analysis.restructuring_framework: SA Companies Act / NY Law Notes
recovery_analysis.thesis: Sibanye announced in Nov-26 the early redemption of its $500m 4.25% 2028 convertible bond to slash gross debt toward ~$1.1bn, backed by Q326 adj EBITDA rising 9% YoY to $662m (R10.8bn) and 0.59x YE25 net leverage. Eliminating the 2028 CB removes ~1/3 of gross debt and de-risks the 2029/2031 senior notes. Structural recovery anchored by South Africa materials asset perimeter and SSW 6.25% Senior Notes Nov 2031 (USG8118LAA64) seniority.
